chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn al-Nu'man, from Abu Asama, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'Adhere to God-consciousness, piety, striving, truthful narration, fulfilling the trust, good character, and good neighborliness. Be callers to yourselves without your tongues, be an adornment and do not be a shame. And adhere to the prolongation of bowing and prostration, for indeed when one of you prolongs his bowing and prostration, Iblis cries out from behind him and says, 'Woe to me! He obeyed and I disobeyed; he prostrated and I refused.'
ai.seo_question: What are the key ethical and worship practices recommended by Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) in this hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) synthesizes moral conduct (akhlaq) with ritual devotion, urging believers to embody piety and truthfulness while maintaining excellent character and neighborly relations. He specifically highlights the spiritual impact of prolonging bowing and prostration (rukūʿ and sujūd), noting that such deep humility causes Iblis to lament his own arrogance and disobedience to God. This teaching underscores the Shia emphasis on the interconnection between inner sincerity and outward worship as a means of spiritual victory over the ego and the devil.
